title: 亚托克斯·萌趣绘本
description: 猩红与炭黑甲面层次分明，尖锐头角呼应巨大的蝠形双翼。

art_direction.medium: cute matte-gouache picture-book mini-character, rounded painted shapes, soft colored-ink edges, visible brush pigment and warm paper
art_direction.identity: Aatrox is a recognizable adult Darkin with crimson and charcoal armor-like surfaces, a sharply horned head, luminous eyes, powerful adult presence in a compact super-deformed illustration, and broad batlike wings folded close in the compact illustration. Preserve his elongated facial structure, imposing shoulder silhouette, and integrated fully covering armored body. His distinctive enormous dark-red greatsword is held vertically with its tip resting on stone, completely inactive.
art_direction.scene: A truly CUTE SUPER-DEFORMED adult Darkin mini-character, about THREE HEADS TALL excluding the horns, with a large recognizable mature Darkin head, broad rounded shoulder plates, a short compact armored torso and short sturdy armored legs. Preserve crimson-charcoal armor, two recognizable horns and two rounded batlike wings partly tucked close to the back. Give his adult masked face softened curious eye lights and an endearingly reserved small head tilt, rather than a stern imposing stance. His inactive greatsword rests vertically on the ground beside him; both gloved hands rest loosely on its rounded pommel. Keep the whole cute compact figure and both wing tips inside the square with ample pale paper. Matte coral-red, plum and warm gold painted shapes, no realistic long-legged adult anatomy.
art_direction.palette: crimson, lilac matte shadow violet, copper rim light, pale stone; preserve canonical signature hues and skin/species colors. Supporting washes: butter yellow, clear sky blue and warm ivory, with a tiny coral accent. Light colored shadows and matte painted highlights.
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing
art_direction.tone: cute and welcoming while preserving canonical age and species

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
